flags: Price gate: base $45 (Oct 2026 Tue) / $47 (June 2027 Tue) on the 30-amp water/electric back-in (25-30 ft sites; EKKO fits), $50-53 on Saturdays; plus a $5 park 'Booking Fee' once per stay (not counted).
